answer.summary: Every API test class fails before running because the Spring ApplicationContext cannot start: a circular bean dependency (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService). Startup wiring is deterministic, so a rerun should fail the same way, not a flake. The PR touches only WorkflowServiceTest.java, so the log does not show whether this PR added the cycle; check recent constructor/injection changes in the workflow and exercise services.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default. Update your application to remove the dependency cycle between beans.
